about: The Central Park Performing Arts Center is marking its 30th anniversary with a season of live entertainment, and this production is one of the holiday shows on that lineup. The center describes it as one of the few large scale holiday kickline productions presented on tour.

The performers are a cast of singers and dancers, and the story is an original Christmas tale rather than a retelling of a classic. The theater is inside Largo Central Park, where the city's Holiday Lights open the same week, so many families pair a show with a walk through the lights afterward.
faq: How much are tickets to The Sunkicks in Largo?
The center lists tickets from $30 to $45 plus applicable fees, with reserved seating.
Which Sunkicks shows still have tickets?
The Friday 8 PM and Saturday 2 PM and 8 PM shows were listed for sale, and the Sunday November 29 matinee shows as sold out. Availability changes, so check the ticket page.
How do I reach the box office?
Call the Central Park Performing Arts Center box office at (727) 587-6793.

about: McGough Nature Park is a city nature park that offers hands on environmental learning for all ages. The park's phone number is 727-518-3047 for questions before you go.

Largo's parks listing for this day shows no admission price, so the price is marked as not listed here. Other programs at the park carry fees, such as the Nature Crafts Class on December 18, which costs $5 per person, so it is worth calling ahead if you plan to combine activities.
The Bird Show at the park, where native Florida raptors are shown up close, runs Tuesdays and Thursdays and is listed as free, though dates change with the weather.
faq: What time is the Christmas Poetry Walk?
It runs from 9 AM to 5 PM on Saturday, December 19, 2026, and you can walk the trails at your own pace.

Is it a good fit for young children?
The program is listed for all ages. It is a self guided walk to read the Christmas poems posted along the trails.
